sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Republicans in this year's midterms are using one person to represent everything that's wrong with the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 今年中期选举中的共和党人正在用一个人来代表民主党的所有问题。

sentences.en: As it turns out, many Democrats are turning on the same figure.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，许多民主党人也在倒戈反对同一个人物。

sentences.en: August 17th.
Alex, last time we talked to you, it was on the eve of the special election in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我们上次和你交谈时，正值俄亥俄州特别选举的前夕。

sentences.en: And you said the election there represented a test of whether the Republican strategy in the midterms would essentially be to run an opposition-only campaign.
sentences.zh: 你说那里的选举代表了一场测试，检验共和党在中期选举中的策略本质上是否会变成一场纯粹的反对派竞选。

sentences.en: Vote for us because we're not the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 投票给我们，因为我们不是民主党人。

sentences.en: And what have we learned since then?
sentences.zh: 从那以后我们学到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we learned that it worked just barely in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们了解到这在俄亥俄州勉强奏效了。

sentences.en: In politics, they call this tight as a tick.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，他们称之为咬得像蜱虫一样紧。

sentences.en: Take a look at these results last night in Ohio's 12th district.
sentences.zh: 看看昨晚俄亥俄州第12选区的这些结果。

sentences.en: This is a special election for the House of Representatives to replace a retiring Republican representative.
sentences.zh: 这是众议院的特别选举，旨在接替一位退休的共和党众议员。

sentences.en: This was an election in a conservative part of the state, a district that President Trump carried by 11 points.
sentences.zh: 这是一场在该州保守派地区的选举，特朗普总统曾以11个百分点的优势在该选区获胜。

sentences.en: The Republican candidate appears to have won there by a little bit less than one percentage point.
sentences.zh: 共和党候选人似乎在那里以不到一个百分点的微弱优势获胜。

sentences.en: They're still counting and litigating some of those votes, but it was really a skin-to-their-teeth kind of victory.
sentences.zh: 他们仍在清点和诉讼部分选票，但这确实是一场极其惊险的胜利。

sentences.en: Alex Burns covers politics for the
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯负责《时报》的

sentences.en: Times.
sentences.zh: 政治报道。

sentences.en: And what Republicans took away from that is that the total war strategy is what it's going to
sentences.zh: 共和党人从中得出的一点是，全面战争策略正是他们所需要的，

sentences.en: take, and it very well might succeed at holding down their losses and holding the House.
sentences.zh: 这很可能会成功减少他们的损失并守住众议院。

sentences.en: And what is that strategy actually looking like in the midterms?
sentences.zh: 这种策略在中期选举中实际看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: It's a very big country, so I imagine that it means running against Democrats differently from district to district.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常大的国家，所以我猜这意味着在不同的选区以不同的方式对抗民主党人。

sentences.en: There are definitely going to be important gradations regionally, depending on the nature of the district.
sentences.zh: 根据选区的性质，各地区肯定会有重要的细微差别。

sentences.en: In more rural areas where the president is stronger, you're going to see Republicans raising more issues like immigration,
sentences.zh: 在总统支持率更高的更偏远农村地区，你会看到共和党人提出更多关于移民的问题，

sentences.en: more issues like football players kneeling and support for the police.
sentences.zh: 更多关于橄榄球运动员单膝下跪以及支持警察的问题。

sentences.en: In more suburban areas where the president is less popular, where more educated Republicans are a little bit shakier on the party,
sentences.zh: 在总统不太受欢迎、受过更多教育的共和党人对党派立场稍显动摇的更多郊区，

sentences.en: you're going to see an equally negative campaign, but probably about some different issues, more about taxes, more about the Iran deal and national security.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一场同样具有攻击性的竞选，但可能关乎一些不同的问题，更多是关于税收、伊核协议和国家安全。

sentences.en: And there are going to be a couple issues that cross all time zones for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 并且会有几个跨越所有时区、对共和党人来说共同的问题。

sentences.en: One of them is Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: They're going to be bringing her up everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们会在任何地方都提起她。

sentences.en: Well, what is that about?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这到底是关于什么的？

sentences.en: Why is she the thing that kind of unifies this strategy for
sentences.zh: 为什么她成了某种程度上统一共和党这一策略的

sentences.en: Republicans?
sentences.zh: 焦点？

sentences.en: Well, she is one of the most unpopular politicians in the country, according to polling conducted by both parties and in every part of the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据两党在全美各地进行的民意调查，她是全国最不受欢迎的政治家之一。

sentences.en: There's not a competitive congressional district where she is a popular character.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个竞争激烈的国会选区是她备受欢迎的。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 这有很多原因。

sentences.en: Republicans have run tens of millions of dollars over the years attacking her, branding her
sentences.zh: 多年来，共和党人花费了数千万美元攻击她，将她塑造为

sentences.en: as this avatar of a radically liberal coastal elitist who looks down on the kind of voters who they're pursuing.
sentences.zh: 一个激进自由派的沿海精英化身，看不起他们正在争取的那类选民。

sentences.en: Another disgusting portrayal of a female politician went viral.
sentences.zh: 另一个对女性政治家的恶心描绘在网上疯传。

sentences.en: This one graphic depicting
sentences.zh: 这幅讽刺画将

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi as Miley Cyrus with her tongue out, bent over before a flexing Jerry Brown.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西描绘成伸出舌头的麦莉·赛勒斯，弯腰站在展示肌肉的杰里·布朗面前。

sentences.en: Even Democrats who see that as a wildly unfair caricature basically concede that the Republican campaign has mostly worked.
sentences.zh: 甚至那些认为这是极其不公平的讽刺画的民主党人也基本承认，共和党的竞选基本上起作用了。

sentences.en: So she's sort of a shorthand for all the reasons why you don't want to let the Democrats take back power.
sentences.zh: 所以她有点像是你不希望让民主党夺回权力的所有理由的代名词。

sentences.en: That's certainly how they're trying to use her.
sentences.zh: 这当然就是他们试图利用她的方式。

sentences.en: But how does it actually work in the campaigns?
sentences.zh: 但这在竞选中到底是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: How do you run a candidate in some district in, say, Ohio, not so much against his actual or her actual opponent, but against Nancy Pelosi?
sentences.zh: 你如何在某个选区（比方说俄亥俄州）推出一位候选人，不是去反对他的实际对手或她的实际对手，而是去反对南希·佩洛西？

sentences.en: Well, what we saw in Ohio and what we saw in a couple of special elections before that, voters would get these campaign mailers at their door that
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在俄亥俄州以及在此之前的几次特别选举中看到的是，选民会在家门口收到这些竞选邮件，

sentences.en: showed whoever the Democratic candidate was in Ohio was Danny O'Connor, this 31-year-old local official, hanging like a marionette from strings held by Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 上面显示在俄亥俄州的民主党候选人——无论是谁，当时是丹尼·奥康纳，这位31岁的当地官员——就像木偶一样挂在南希·佩洛西掌控的线上。

sentences.en: After lying the whole campaign, dishonest Danny O'Connor now admits he'd vote for Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 在整个竞选期间撒谎后，不诚实的丹尼·奥康纳现在承认他会投票给佩洛西。

sentences.en: Pelosi's running for re-election.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西正在竞选连任。

sentences.en: I would support whoever the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 我会支持民主党里的任何人。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Whoever the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 民主党里的任何人。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dishonest Danny lied about Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 不诚实的丹尼对佩洛西撒了谎。

sentences.en: Now he's lying about Social Security and Medicare.
sentences.zh: 现在他又在社保和医疗保险问题上撒谎。

sentences.en: O'Connor supports a Pelosi-backed plan that cuts Medicare spending by $800 billion.
sentences.zh: 奥康纳支持佩洛西支持的削减8000亿美元医疗保险开支的计划。

sentences.en: You have seen in the past ads that would morph candidates' faces into Nancy Pelosi's face, and that's just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 你过去见过将候选人的脸变形为南希·佩洛西的脸的广告，而这只是开始。

sentences.en: You're going to see this in virtually every competitive election around the country this fall.
sentences.zh: 今年秋天，你将在全国几乎每一场竞争激烈的选举中看到这一点。

sentences.en: Meet Washington insider Andy Kim.
sentences.zh: 认识华盛顿内部人士安迪·金。

sentences.en: Pelosi supports Kim because
sentences.zh: 佩洛西支持金，因为

sentences.en: Kim supports her liberal agenda.
sentences.zh: 金支持她的自由派议程。

sentences.en: Andy Kim is a Pelosi liberal.
sentences.zh: 安迪·金是一个佩洛西式的自由派。

sentences.en: He's not one of us.
sentences.zh: 他不是我们自己人。

sentences.en: Sharice Davids supports a government takeover of health care that would nearly double the national bet.
sentences.zh: 沙里丝·戴维斯支持政府接管医疗保健，这将使国家债务几乎翻倍。

sentences.en: It's why Nancy Pelosi's allies have spent $700,000 backing Davids.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么南希·佩洛西的盟友花费了70万美元支持戴维斯。

sentences.en: Sharice Davids is a Pelosi liberal.
sentences.zh: 沙里丝·戴维斯是一个佩洛西式的自由派。

sentences.en: Republicans just try to turn every individual House campaign into a referendum on who should lead the House overall, right?
sentences.zh: 共和党人只是试图将每一场独立的众议院竞选变成一场全民公投，决定究竟谁应该领导众议院，对吧？

sentences.en: So that doesn't matter how much you might like Michael
sentences.zh: 所以无论你可能多么喜欢迈克尔·

sentences.en: Barbaro or how appealing you might find his ads, a vote for Michael is a vote for Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 巴巴罗，或者你觉得他的广告多么有吸引力，投迈克尔一票就是投南希·佩洛西一票。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi and Anthony Brindisi's liberal agenda is too extreme for upstate New York.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西和安东尼·布林迪西的自由派议程对纽约州北部来说太极端了。

sentences.en: Under Nancy
sentences.zh: 在南希·

sentences.en: Pelosi and Anthony Brindisi, our economy crashed.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西和安东尼·布林迪西的领导下，我们的经济崩溃了。

sentences.en: Reckless spending, devastating unemployment, higher taxes.
sentences.zh: 鲁莽的开支、毁灭性的失业率、更高的税收。

sentences.en: Claudia Tenney is fighting for President Trump's agenda in Washington.
sentences.zh: 克劳迪娅·坦尼正在华盛顿为特朗普总统的议程而战。

sentences.en: Like a direct one-to-one.
sentences.zh: 就像直接的一对一。

sentences.en: One-to-one.
sentences.zh: 一对一。

sentences.en: You're really just voting on who the Speaker of the House is going to be.
sentences.zh: 你实际上只是在投票决定谁将成为众议院议长。

sentences.en: So Pelosi is to Republicans in this strategy what President Trump is to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以对于采取这种策略的共和党人来说，佩洛西就相当于民主党人眼中的特朗普总统。

sentences.en: In other words, they realize they need a counterweight boogeyman.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们意识到他们需要一个平衡的妖魔化靶子。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And how are Democrats responding to this campaign against their party leader?
sentences.zh: 那么民主党人是如何回应针对他们党领袖的这场竞选的呢？

sentences.en: For the most part, Democrats who are running in the toughest races are trying to distance themselves from Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，在竞争最激烈的选区参选的民主党人都在试图与南希·佩洛西保持距离。

sentences.en: Congressman Hill opened his campaign by attacking me, knowing full well that I've said from day one that I won't vote for Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 希尔国会议员以攻击我开启了他的竞选，他明明知道我从第一天起就说过我不会投票给南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: We're better than that.
sentences.zh: 我们比这更好。

sentences.en: They're not necessarily saying negative things about her, but it's hard to find a Democrat running
sentences.zh: 他们不一定会说她的坏话，但很难在竞争激烈的选区找到一个竞选国会议员的民主党人，

sentences.en: for Congress in a really competitive district who has expressed an intention to support her again, a desire to make her Speaker again.
sentences.zh: 表达过再次支持她的意愿，或者表达过让她再次担任议长的愿望。

sentences.en: A number of them have said they won't vote for her under any circumstances to try to blunt those Republican attacks.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人表示，在任何情况下都不会投票给她，以此来削弱共和党的这些攻击。

sentences.en: Paul Ryan is retiring, so Republicans will have a new leader.
sentences.zh: 保罗·瑞恩正在退休，所以共和党人将迎来一位新领袖。

sentences.en: Democrats also need a fresh start.
sentences.zh: 民主党人也需要一个崭新的开始。

sentences.en: That's why I won't be voting for Nancy Pelosi for leader.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我不会投票支持南希·佩洛西担任领袖。

sentences.en: Instead, I'll push to find a new leadership team that ensures Congress works for all of us.
sentences.zh: 相反，我将推动寻找一个新的领导团队，确保国会为我们所有人服务。

sentences.en: Montanans deserve nothing less.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州人民理应获得更好的。

sentences.en: More often what you hear is Democrats talking more vaguely about new leadership in Washington,
sentences.zh: 你更常听到的是民主党人更含糊地谈论华盛顿的新领导层，

sentences.en: that they try to tie in change on their own side with the change that they're trying to bring to control of Washington overall.
sentences.zh: 他们试图将自身一侧的变革与他们试图带给华盛顿整体控制权的变革联系起来。

sentences.en: I grew up in a small town here in rural Ohio, the type of place where folks go to football games on
sentences.zh: 我在俄亥俄州乡村的一个小镇长大，那种地方的人们在

sentences.en: Friday nights, people help each other out, people work really hard, but also it's full of a lot of folks who I think have been forgotten in some ways.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上去看橄榄球比赛，人们互相帮助，人们工作非常努力，但这里也充满了许多我认为在某些方面被遗忘的人。

sentences.en: I think we need a change in leadership on both sides of the aisle.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要两党领导层的变革。

sentences.en: Paul Ryan's not doing anything for working families, but we need new leadership on the
sentences.zh: 保罗·瑞恩没有为工薪家庭做任何事，但我们也需要在

sentences.en: Democratic side of things too.
sentences.zh: 民主党方面有新的领导层。

sentences.en: We need a new generation of leadership.
sentences.zh: 我们需要新一代的领导层。

sentences.en: I'm Danny O'Connor, and I approve this message.
sentences.zh: 我是丹尼·奥康纳，我批准这条信息。

sentences.en: So they're suggesting that it's time for her to perhaps not be the leader of the Democrats in the House.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是在暗示，也许是时候让她不再担任众议院民主党领袖了。

sentences.en: Some of them are going a good deal further than suggesting.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人的言论比暗示要深入得多。

sentences.en: Some of them are saying pretty bluntly that it's time for her to go.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人相当直白地表示，是时候让她离开了。

sentences.en: There's even a block of Democrats in the House, mostly younger Democrats, who have come out and said that she should consider leaving before the election
sentences.zh: 众议院甚至还有一个民主党人集团，主要是较年轻的民主党人，他们公开表示她应该考虑在选举前离开，

sentences.en: or stating that she won't seek the speakership again in order to take that whole issue off the table as an electoral tactic for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 或者声明她不会再次寻求议长职位，以便将整个问题从桌面上抹去，不再作为共和党人的选举策略。

sentences.en: Among folks led by the congressman from Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 在以来自马萨诸塞州的国会议员

sentences.en: Seth Moulton.
sentences.zh: 赛斯·莫尔顿为首的人群中。

sentences.en: My positions on party leadership are very clear, and I've been calling for our leaders to step
sentences.zh: 我对党内领导层的立场非常明确，我长期以来一直呼吁我们的领导人

sentences.en: down and to allow a new generation of leaders to step up and lead our party forward for a long time.
sentences.zh: 辞职，让新一代领导人站出来，引领我们的党向前发展。

sentences.en: Member of Congress from Long Island, Kathleen Rice.
sentences.zh: 来自长岛的国会议员凯瑟琳·赖斯。

sentences.en: We need a winning strategy, and I think the first step to getting to a winning strategy is a change in leadership.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个获胜的策略，我认为实现获胜策略的第一步就是领导层的更迭。

sentences.en: Both younger, newer Democrats.
sentences.zh: 既有更年轻的民主党人，也有更新的民主党人。

sentences.en: There is this insistent argument that it could cost them control of the House to have an unpopular leader, or they could just end up sacrificing
sentences.zh: 有一种坚定的观点认为，拥有一个不受欢迎的领导人可能会让他们失去对众议院的控制，或者他们最终可能会牺牲掉

sentences.en: winnable seats that end up just out of reach because Republican voters mobilize against Nancy
sentences.zh: 那些原本唾手可得但最终失之交臂的胜利席位，因为共和党选民针对南希·

sentences.en: Pelosi.

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，今天就下载《时报》App，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 周四，歌手艾瑞莎·富兰克林因癌症并发症去世，享年76岁。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the singer Aretha Franklin died of complications from cancer at the age of 76.
sentences.zh: 每个人都称艾瑞莎·富兰克林为灵魂乐女王，因为她是20世纪60年代灵魂乐的核心人物。

sentences.en: Everybody called Aretha Franklin the Queen of Soul because she was at the center of 1960s soul music.
sentences.zh: 我的同事约翰·佩雷利斯作为《时报》的流行音乐评论员，几年来一直关注着富兰克林的职业生涯。

sentences.en: My colleague John Perelis has followed Franklin's career for decades as pop music critic for The
sentences.zh: 时报

sentences.en: Times.
sentences.zh: 艾瑞莎·富兰克林演唱的大多数歌曲都是情歌，但这些情歌涵盖了爱情的各个领域，从深切的渴望到不屈的力量。

sentences.en: Most of what Aretha Franklin sang were love songs, but they were love songs that talked about every area of love, from deep longing to indomitable strength.
sentences.zh: 她出身于福音教堂，将她在教堂学到的一切以及

sentences.en: She came out of the gospel church, brought all that she had learned in the church and all
sentences.zh: 从爵士乐和流行乐中学到的一切融入60年代末的灵魂乐中，为整整一代人定义了灵魂乐。

sentences.en: that she had learned from jazz and pop, put it into soul songs in the late 60s that defined soul music for a generation.
sentences.zh: 每个人对艾瑞莎·富兰克林的第一印象都是她的嗓音。

sentences.en: The first thing that strikes everybody about Aretha Franklin is her voice.
sentences.zh: 但鲜为人知的是，她还是一位编曲家、音乐架构师。

sentences.en: But lesser known about her is that she was also an arranger, a musical architect.
sentences.zh: 她走进录音室唱完所有声部，告诉乐队要演奏什么律动、吉他华彩、号角乐段，和声伴唱全都在她的脑海里。

sentences.en: She walked in and sang all the parts, told the bands the groove to play, the guitar licks, the horn lines, the backup singers were all in her head.
sentences.zh: 你听到像《Think》这样的歌。

sentences.en: You hear songs like Think.
sentences.zh: 你听到像《Chain of Fools》这样的歌。

sentences.en: You hear songs like Chain of Fools.
sentences.zh: 她像流行歌手、布鲁斯歌手、灵魂乐歌手一样歌唱人际关系。

sentences.en: And she's singing about relationships as pop singers do, as blues singers do, as soul singers do.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，很难分辨这究竟是精湛的音乐造诣还是肺腑的倾诉。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's hard to tell if it's musicianship or confession.
sentences.zh: 你对我很不好。

sentences.en: You're treating me badly.
sentences.zh: 你没有尊重我。

sentences.en: You're not respecting me.
sentences.zh: 你没有给我应得的，这与说你没有给我所需的有所不同。

sentences.en: You're not giving me what I deserve, which is different from saying you're not giving me what I need.
sentences.zh: 这是你没有给我应得的。

sentences.en: It's you're not giving me what I deserve.
sentences.zh: 《Respect》原本是奥蒂斯·雷丁的一首歌。

sentences.en: Respect was an Otis Redding song.
sentences.zh: 艾瑞莎拿过这首歌，以你意想不到的最奇怪的音符开场，彻底重塑了

sentences.en: Aretha takes this song, comes in on the strangest note you'd ever expect, completely revamps the
sentences.zh: 节奏，彻底将其切分，它就成了我们都喜爱的国际赞歌。

sentences.en: rhythm, completely syncopates it, and it becomes the international anthem that we all love.
sentences.zh: 《Respect》是那个时代的象征。

sentences.en: Respect was a symbol of its time.
sentences.zh: 正如她在一次采访中告诉我的那样，这首歌是她非常清醒地在思考女性的尊严、民权。

sentences.en: Respect was a song that she very consciously, she told me in an interview, was thinking about respect for women, respect for civil rights.
sentences.zh: 这关乎一个女性的角色，从一个男性手中把这首歌接管过来。

sentences.en: It was about the role of specifically a woman, taking the song over from a man.
And this was 1967.
sentences.zh: 那是70年代妇女解放运动之前。

sentences.en: This was before the women's liberation movement of the 70s.
sentences.zh: 她还为马丁·路德·金的民权集会献唱，将自己投身于这项事业。

sentences.en: She was also singing at civil rights rallies for Martin Luther King, putting herself at the disposal of the cause.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于一个女性来说，这是一个非常强有力的表态。

sentences.en: So this was a very strong statement for a woman to be making.
sentences.zh: 这就是艾瑞莎·富兰克林带给每一首歌的东西——能够触及你最深处、

sentences.en: That's what Aretha Franklin brought to every song, was the ability to get to your deepest
sentences.zh: 最温柔的情感，理解它们并将它们转化为力量源泉的能力。

sentences.en: and most tender emotions and to understand them and turn them into a source of strength.

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、必须全黑才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
